newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen unit starts cable online service.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen unit starts cable online service.

text.p: A unit of German steel and engineering giant Thyssen said on Wednesday it had launched the first German online service using a television cable network to provide faster access to the Internet.

"Over cable networks, customers can reach Internet web pages 16 times faster than over the telephone lines," vice chairman of Thyssen Telekom Hans-Peter Kohlhammer said, announcing the service at the Munich Advertising Conference.
The cable service will also allow nearly 400,000 households in the southern state of Bavaria to connect to an municipal information service called "Cyber City," Kohlhammer said.
The Munich service will be managed by Thyssen Telecom, Thyssen-subsidiary Internet Services and local cable company Kabel & Medien, he added.
